description: This file defines the 'Constraint' interface for table data restrictions in Apache Spark, including methods for constraint properties, validation, and builders for specific constraint types.

classes.name: Constraint
classes.description: Interface representing a data constraint in a table, with methods for retrieving constraint details and builders for specific constraint types.

classes.name: Constraint.ValidationStatus
classes.description: Enum indicating the validation state of a constraint: VALID, INVALID, or UNVALIDATED.

methods.name: name
methods.description: Returns the name of this constraint.

methods.name: enforced
methods.description: Indicates whether this constraint is actively enforced.

methods.name: validationStatus
methods.description: Returns the validation status of the constraint.

methods.name: rely
methods.description: Indicates whether the constraint is assumed to hold if validation is unknown.

methods.name: toDDL
methods.description: Returns the constraint definition in DDL format.

methods.name: toDescription
methods.description: Provides a description of the constraint for table metadata output.
